name: Counter-Strike 2
antiCheat: VAC. Never modify game files or inject into the process; launch options and video settings are allowed.

configFiles.notes: Valve KeyValues format, not INI or JSON: propose changes as manualGuidance (in-game menu or exact line), not file.ini.
Optional user autoexec; console commands such as fps_max.

competitiveSettings: fps_max 0 or a cap well above the refresh rate
multisampling and shader detail by GPU headroom
cloudSync: Steam Cloud may sync cfg files; edits made while Steam is closed are the safest.
benchmark: Workshop map 'CS2 FPS BENCHMARK' (same map, same run) before and after.
typicalBound: Strongly CPU and memory-latency bound at high FPS; cache and RAM tuning matter more than GPU settings.
caveats: Starting knowledge, not verified on this PC. Read the files with powershell-read before proposing changes.
